placeholders.food_en: some packaged snacks and tea bags

questions.en: What is the purpose of your trip?
questions.zh: 你這趟來的目的是什麼？
questions.tip_zh: 最常見的第一題。回答要短、誠實、跟你的簽證和事實一致，不要背長篇大論。

answers.en: I'm here {{purpose_en}}. I'll be in {{city_en}} for {{days_en}} days.

questions.en: Why are you visiting the United States?
questions.tip_zh: 跟上一題是同一件事，換個問法而已，答案一樣就好。

answers.en: I'm here {{purpose_en}} — it's a trip I've been planning for a long time.
answers.zh: 我來{{purpose_zh}}，這趟旅行我計畫很久了。

questions.en: Is this your first time in the U.S.?
questions.zh: 這是你第一次來美國嗎？
questions.tip_zh: 照實回答就好，海關電腦查得到你的入境紀錄。

answers.en: No, I've been here once before, a few years ago.
answers.zh: 不是，我幾年前來過一次。

questions.en: Are you here for business or pleasure?
questions.zh: 你是來出差還是休閒旅遊？
questions.tip_zh: 觀光、度假、探親都算 pleasure；去開會、看展那種短期商務才算 business。照實回答就好。

questions.en: What are you planning to do while you're here?
questions.zh: 你在美國期間打算做什麼？
questions.tip_zh: 講大方向就好（觀光、逛街、看景點），不用背出每天的行程表。

answers.en: Mostly sightseeing — I want to see the main spots in {{city_en}}, and do some shopping.
answers.zh: 主要是觀光，想看看{{city_zh}}的著名景點，再逛街購物。

questions.en: How long will you be staying in the U.S.?
questions.tip_zh: 天數要跟回程機票對得上。免簽（ESTA）最多 90 天。

answers.en: I'll be here for {{days_en}} days. I fly back on {{return_date_en}}.

questions.en: When are you flying back?
Do you have a return ticket?
questions.tip_zh: 先把回程機票的畫面截圖存在手機相簿，隨時拿得出來。

answers.en: Yes, I do. I can show you on my phone if you'd like.
answers.zh: 有，需要的話我可以用手機給你看。

questions.en: Where will you go after the U.S.?
questions.zh: 離開美國之後你要去哪裡？

answers.en: I'm flying straight back to Taiwan.

questions.en: Where will you be staying?
questions.tip_zh: 把飯店名稱和地址存在手機備忘錄或相簿，被追問地址時直接拿出來看。

questions.en: Are you staying with friends or family?

answers.en: No, I'm staying at a hotel.
Yes, I'm staying with my friend. I have the address right here.
answers.zh: 對，我住朋友家，地址在這裡。

questions.en: Do you have the address of where you're staying?

answers.en: Yes, it's on my phone. One moment, please.
answers.zh: 有，在我手機裡，請稍等一下。

questions.en: Will you be staying anywhere else during your trip?
questions.zh: 這趟旅程還會住其他地方嗎？

answers.en: No, just that hotel the whole time.
answers.zh: 沒有，全程都住那間飯店。

answers.en: Yes, I'll spend a few nights in another city as well. I have all the bookings on my phone.
answers.zh: 會，我也會去另一個城市住幾晚，訂房紀錄都在我手機裡。

questions.en: What do you do for a living?
questions.tip_zh: 講大類就好（行銷、會計、老師），不用解釋職稱細節。

answers.en: I work in {{occupation_en}} back in Taiwan.
answers.zh: 我在台灣做{{occupation_zh}}相關的工作。

questions.en: Who do you work for?
questions.tip_zh: 可以直接講公司名字；講不出英文名就說 a company in Taiwan。

answers.en: I work for a company in Taiwan.
answers.zh: 我在台灣的一間公司上班。

questions.en: Are you planning to work while you're in the U.S.?
questions.zh: 你打算在美國期間工作嗎？
questions.tip_zh: 只要你確實不會在美國工作，就清楚堅定地說 No，猶豫容易被進一步詢問。一切照實回答——觀光身分在美國工作是大忌。

answers.en: No, not at all. I'm just here {{purpose_en}}.

questions.en: Do you have a job to go back to in Taiwan?
questions.tip_zh: 海關想確認你會回國。有穩定工作＝會回去，是加分答案。

answers.en: Yes, I do. I'm going right back to work after this trip.
answers.zh: 有，這趟旅程結束我就回去上班。

questions.en: How much money are you carrying?
questions.tip_zh: 講大約數字就好，記得提一句有信用卡，表示旅費充足。

answers.en: About {{cash_en}} in cash, plus credit cards.
answers.zh: 現金大約 {{cash_zh}}，另外還有信用卡。

questions.en: Are you carrying more than ten thousand dollars?
questions.zh: 你有帶超過一萬美金嗎？
questions.tip_zh: 一萬美金是「同行的人加總」計算，而且不只現金，旅行支票等也算。帶超過不違法但必須申報；沒申報被查到會被沒收＋罰款。沒帶那麼多就放心說 No。

answers.en: No, nowhere near that. Just {{cash_en}} or so.
answers.zh: 沒有，差得遠，大概就 {{cash_zh}} 左右。

questions.en: Who paid for this trip?
Are you bringing any food with you?
questions.tip_zh: 台灣人最常被問的一題。所有食物都要誠實申報——包裝零食、茶葉申報後通常沒問題；被查到沒申報才會罰錢。

answers.en: Yes, {{food_en}} — everything is sealed and packaged.
No, I don't have any food with me.

questions.en: Do you have any fresh fruit, vegetables, or meat?
questions.zh: 你有帶新鮮水果、蔬菜或肉類嗎？
questions.tip_zh: 肉類製品幾乎都不能帶——肉鬆、肉乾、含肉泡麵都算。出發前就不要放進行李。

answers.en: No fresh food, and no meat. Only sealed, packaged snacks.
answers.zh: 沒有生鮮食品也沒有肉類，只有密封包裝的零食。

questions.en: Did you pack your bags yourself?
questions.zh: 行李是你自己打包的嗎？

answers.zh: 對，全部都是我自己打包的。

questions.en: Are you carrying anything for someone else?
questions.tip_zh: 絕對不要幫別人帶來路不明的東西，這題也要能毫不猶豫說 No。

answers.en: No, everything in my luggage is mine.
answers.zh: 沒有，行李裡的東西都是我自己的。

questions.en: Do you have anything to declare?
questions.tip_zh: 有食物就直接申報，不用等對方追問；其他不確定的東西就用問的，誠實永遠比亂答 No 安全。

questions.en: Are you bringing any gifts?

answers.en: Yes, a few small souvenirs from Taiwan — snacks and tea.
answers.zh: 有，一些台灣的小伴手禮，零食和茶葉。

questions.en: Are you bringing any medication?
questions.tip_zh: 藥品要照實申報。自用藥帶合理份量（一般以 90 天內用量為原則），處方藥帶著本人的處方簽或藥袋；部分管制成分可能不准入境，不確定的藥出發前先查。

answers.en: Yes, just some over-the-counter medicine for personal use, like cold medicine.
answers.zh: 有，一些自用的成藥，像感冒藥。

questions.en: Do you have any alcohol or tobacco?
questions.tip_zh: 滿 21 歲通常可以免稅帶 1 公升酒；超過通常是申報＋補稅，不是違規。數量正常就照實說，不用緊張。

answers.en: Yes, one bottle of wine — it's a gift.

questions.en: Have you visited a farm or been in contact with any livestock recently?
questions.zh: 你最近有去過農場或接觸過家畜嗎？
questions.tip_zh: 這是申報單上的固定題。有去過就照實申報，後續可能有鞋子清潔或農業檢查等處理，配合就好。

answers.en: Yes, I visited a farm in Taiwan recently.
answers.zh: 有，我最近在台灣去過農場。

questions.en: Are you traveling alone?
Do you know anyone in the United States?
questions.zh: 你在美國有認識的人嗎？
questions.tip_zh: 照實回答。有朋友就說有，沒有就說沒有，這題沒有標準答案。

answers.en: No, I don't know anyone here.
answers.zh: 沒有，我在這裡不認識任何人。

answers.en: Yes, I have a friend living in {{city_en}}. We'll meet up during my trip.
answers.zh: 有，我有個朋友住在{{city_zh}}，這趟會見面。

questions.en: Is anyone meeting you at the airport?

answers.en: No one — I'll take a taxi to my hotel.
answers.zh: 沒有，我會自己搭車去飯店。

answers.en: Yes, my friend is picking me up.

categories.intro_zh: 聽不懂完全不用慌——海關每天遇到幾百個英文不好的旅客。用這些句子請對方放慢或重講，比亂猜亂答安全一百倍。

questions.en: Sorry, could you say that again, please?
questions.zh: 不好意思，可以請你再說一次嗎？
questions.tip_zh: 沒聽清楚的第一反應就用這句，非常常用、非常禮貌。

questions.en: Could you speak a little more slowly, please?
questions.tip_zh: 放心開口請對方放慢，他們寧願你聽懂再回答。

questions.en: Sorry, my English isn't very good.
questions.zh: 不好意思，我英文不太好。
questions.tip_zh: 先講這句，對方通常會改用比較簡單的英文慢慢說。

questions.en: I'm sorry, I don't understand.
questions.tip_zh: 真的聽不懂就直說，不要點頭裝懂——亂答 Yes 才會出事。

questions.en: Here's my passport.
questions.tip_zh: 遞護照時講這句就很得體。

questions.en: Excuse me, where should I go next?
questions.zh: 請問我接下來要去哪裡？
questions.tip_zh: 過完關不知道往哪走（領行李、轉機）就用這句問工作人員。
